input.prompt: Locked-camera 16:9 ambient overlay for an ORIGINAL colorful fungal-infected city tower-defense map. Plain near-black compositing background. Animate ONLY separated environmental effects: slow drifting spores, a few softly pulsing magenta/cyan mycelium threads, tiny mushroom caps opening and closing, faint fluorescent runoff shimmer, occasional floating dust motes, one gentle bioluminescent pulse. Motion is slow, loop-friendly, playful, non-cinematic. No roads, no buildings, no characters, no text, no UI, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts. Designed for additive/screen compositing over a static Unity map.
